description.value: The Egg Store is a family-owned farm retail shop selling farm-fresh eggs picked daily and brought directly from local farms. It carries multiple varieties including freerange, organic, double yolkers, and enriched white eggs in bulk and by the dozen. A standout feature for passing cyclists is the on-site 'Eggspress' egg vending machine, stocked daily with fresh eggs for after-hours purchases.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The front page of theeggstore.ca loaded successfully, confirming an active business with product listings across multiple egg varieties. The website explicitly describes an 'Eggspress' egg vending machine stocked daily for after-hours access, confirming the vending machine amenity. Postal code V2T 5X2 is an Abbotsford-area code and the website links to 'Abbotsford's Circle Farm Tour,' suggesting the OSM community tag of 'Chilliwack' is likely incorrect.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Chilliwack' but postal code V2T 5X2 is an Abbotsford-area code and the website references Abbotsford's Circle Farm Tour — location is likely Abbotsford, not Chilliwack.
Contact and delivery subpages returned 404; phone number and street address could not be verified from retrieved website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active farm retail store with a functioning website and product listings; useful to touring cyclists as a source of farm-fresh eggs including via an after-hours vending machine.

Basic groceries.detail: Sells farm-fresh eggs in multiple varieties (freerange, organic, double yolkers, enriched white) available individually, by the dozen, or in bulk trays; egg-only specialty retail

Vending machines.detail: Website describes an 'Eggspress' egg vending machine on-site, stocked daily with fresh eggs and available when the store is closed

wow_evidence: on-site 'Eggspress' egg vending machine, stocked daily with fresh eggs for after-hours purchases
